reason: Bridges the Kimi CLI into DeepSeek Harness as an external coding-agent tool, supporting session orchestration, continuation, cancellation, and live activity display.

summaries.zh: 将 Kimi CLI 集成到 DeepSeek Harness 中，用于调用、继续、取消并在会话界面中查看外部编码智能体任务。
summaries.en: Integrates the Kimi CLI with DeepSeek Harness to invoke, continue, abort, and monitor external coding-agent sessions in the conversation interface.

capabilities: Invokes the Kimi CLI with prompts in the session working directory
Runs asynchronous or blocking external agent sessions with concurrency and timeout limits
Displays agent activity, transcripts, and tool output in a web conversation tab
Can use an unrestricted user Kimi home when reviewOnly is disabled
